def can_bob_win(n, ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy):
    # Check if the target is within the same row, column, or diagonal as the queen
    if ax == bx or ay == by or abs(ax - bx) == abs(ay - by):
        return "NO"
    
    # Check if the target is within the same row, column, or diagonal as the king
    if bx == cx or by == cy or abs(bx - cx) == abs(by - cy):
        return "NO"
    
    # If the target is not in the same row, column, or diagonal as the queen or king, Bob can win
    return "YES"

cx, cy = map(int, input().split())

print(can_bob_win(n, ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy))
